title: Per-segment QoS metrics and tool-call span coalescing with client-side redaction hints
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a focused feature that (1) emits fine-grained per-segment Quality-of-Service (QoS) metrics for streaming responses (latency, jitter, token-rate, partial-error-rate), (2) groups/ coalesces tracing spans for sequences of tool/function calls emitted during a single streaming session to reduce span cardinality, and (3) surfaces client-side redaction hints so logs and traces can tag or mask partial tokens deterministically. This ticket defines schema changes, telemetry naming, sampling policy, redaction hint format, and a phased rollout path for hosted and dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New per-segment metrics are in telemetry pipeline and visible on a per-session dashboard (latency_ms, jitter_ms, tokens_per_second, partial_token_errors_total). 2) Tool/function calls within the same logical stream window are represented by a single coalesced span with child annotations for each call detail. 3) Redaction hint header (X-Redwood-Stream-Redact) is honored by logging/ingestion so partial-token fragments are replaced with <REDACTED> in logs. 4) Backwards compatibility: clients without the new header show no behavioral change. 5) Unit and e2e tests exist for metric emission, span coalescing, and redaction logic.
implementation_notes: Telemetry schema: use metric prefix ria.stream.segment.{metric}. Tags: model, region, deployment_type, shard_id, session_id. Emit histograms for latency_ms and jitter_ms; counters for partial_token_errors_total. Tracing: introduce "stream.session.coalesced" span with duration covering multiple tool calls; attach child events "tool.call" with attributes {name, status, duration_ms, token_delta}. Coalescing rules: window=200ms by default, max_events=10, boundary on newline or EOS. Redaction: client sets header X-Redwood-Stream-Redact: policy=partial|aggressive; server emits telemetry redaction_hint tag and replaces sensitive fragments in debug logs. Ensure redaction is deterministic for replay and compliant with PII controls. Add flag runtime.feature.stream_coalesce=true for gradual rollout.
testing_plan: 1) Unit tests for metric tags and sample distributions (jest + go test). 2) Integration test that simulates high-frequency tool calls and asserts single coalesced span creation (tracing-test harness). 3) Fuzz tests around partial token boundary redaction to ensure no out-of-order masking. 4) Load test on dedicated nodes to validate metric throughput and negligible latency increase (<3ms median). 5) QA checklist for console dashboard panels and telemetry ingestion (Influx -> Grafana queries).
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable on 5% hosted traffic and a single internal dedicated shard with runtime flag set; monitor dashboards for metric integrity and error spikes for 72 hours. Phase 2: increase to 25% after 7 days if no regressions; run targeted correctness tests for redaction on sample sessions. Phase 3: full rollout with migration runbook and opt-out for enterprise customers for 30 days. Provide a console toggle in runtime-1.22 to disable coalescing per-deployment.
comments: 2025-02-14 - Aisha Patel: Initial draft and acceptance criteria posted. TL;DR: aim to reduce span explosion for tool-heavy agents and make redaction deterministic for streaming logs.

2025-02-16 - Marco Nguyen: Spike completed — implemented prototype coalescing logic in runtime/spans. Observed 6x reduction in span count on synthetic tool-call workload. Need to evaluate tracing storage cost tradeoffs.

2025-02-17 - Evelyn Ross (SRE): Noted an edge case where coalescing across session boundary caused orphaned spans in trace trees. Proposed using explicit session heartbeat to close windows; added as implementation constraint.

2025-02-18 - Security (Lina Ortega): Reviewed redaction approach. Requested that redaction_hint never be logged in plaintext and that redaction policy default to 'aggressive' for hosted public tier. Security review ticket opened: ENG-35199.
2025-02-19 - Marco Nguyen: Added integration tests for redaction fuzzing. Found one failing case where UTF-8 split across TCP frames produced partial-token false negatives; patch pending in PR #4982.

2025-02-20 - Product (Jon Park): Confirmed business requirements: dashboards must surface per-customer SLO violations attributable to streaming jitter. Asked for exportable CSV for top offending sessions. Adding as follow-up task PM-412.
2025-02-20 - Marco Nguyen: Marking this ticket In Progress. Draft PR linked; will seek review from runtime, telemetry, and security owners.
